analysis.evidence: מִמֵּשָׁא marks the starting point and בֹּאֲכָה סְפָרָה gives the direction toward Sephar. וַיְהִי links מוֹשָׁבָם to this description of where their dwelling place was.
analysis.morphology: The conjunction וַ precedes the Qal wayyiqtol, third person masculine singular, agreeing with מוֹשָׁבָם, “their dwelling place.”
analysis.sense: to be in a state or condition

analysis.evidence: מִמֵּשָׁא gives the starting point, “from Mesha,” and בֹּאֲכָה סְפָרָה gives the direction, “as one goes toward Sephar.” Together they describe the extent of the territory where the group lived.
analysis.morphology: Masculine singular noun in the construct state with a third-person masculine plural possessive suffix, “their.”
analysis.sense: the territory in which a people lives

analysis.evidence: מוֹשָׁבָם means “their dwelling place.” The phrase מִמֵּשָׁא gives the point from which their territory extends, and בֹּאֲכָה סְפָרָה gives the direction, “toward Sephar.”
analysis.morphology: The prefixed preposition מִן means “from.” Its נ assimilates to the initial מ of the place name מֵשָׁא, producing the dagesh in מֵּ.
analysis.sense: Mesha, the starting point in the description of the Joktanites’ territory
